free_tier.stated: A free trial of the platform with 300 testing minutes and no credit card required; the self-serve Startup plan starts at $83 a month for 500 testing minutes a month on public cloud access.
free_tier.notes: The 300 minutes are the sign-up trial shown on the free-trial registration page, which says 'Start testing on real devices ... 300 testing minutes' and 'No credit card required'. The service subscription agreement sets the trial period at thirty days. The self-serve paid tiers, not the trial, carry the published rates: Startup starts at $83 a month for 500 minutes, Accelerate at $399 a month for 3,000 minutes, and Scale at $9,000 a year for 7,500 minutes a month, annual only.

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: the metered unit is device testing minutes, not a stored object
per_object_cap.notes: No per-object size cap is published on the pricing, trial or agreement pages read.

retention.stated: unverified: no test-result or screenshot retention period is stated on the pricing, trial or agreement pages read

egress.terms: not published: the pages read state no outbound traffic allowance, quota or price; the agreement says the service remotely accesses websites and mobile apps on real devices and caps usage in testing minutes and parallel tests rather than in transferred bytes

interface_detail: The public cloud is driven through the Kobiton dashboard and through Appium, Selenium, Espresso and XCUITest scripts; the agreement names SDKs, plug-ins, command-line tools and on-prem or edge agents as Kobiton Code.
endpoint: unverified: no API endpoint URL is published on the pages read
tooling: Appium, Selenium, Espresso and XCUITest scripts against hosted real devices; CI integrations for Jenkins, GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Travis CI, Azure DevOps, Buildkite and others are listed on the pricing page.
chaining: Testing minutes on hosted real devices fit into a CI pipeline that checks a mobile build before release; screenshots, videos and network logs are captured during each test.

limits.value: 500 testing minutes a month on Startup, 3,000 minutes a month on Accelerate, 7,500 minutes a month on Scale (annual only)
300 testing minutes in the free sign-up trial, within a 30-day trial period

limits_note: Parallel Tests is defined in the agreement as the number of tests Permitted Users collectively run at one time on Remote Access Environments; the scope-of-use limits including Parallel Tests are designated in the Order Form and are not published on the pricing page. Hosted Private Device Slots carry a 5-device minimum. Appium script generation is limited on the self-serve plans.
binding_note: The published self-serve plans are denominated in testing minutes per month, so the minute allowance runs out before any unpublished byte or device cap: the trial grants 300 minutes and Startup grants 500 minutes a month.

identity_cost.detail: The free-trial registration page offers 'Sign up with Google', 'Sign up with GitHub' or 'Or sign up with email', asks for a Work Email and says 'No credit card required'. No phone number, ID document or institution is asked for on that page.

reliability_note: The agreement reserves the right to terminate a trial subscription at any time for any reason and states no warranty, indemnity, data archiving, service level or support obligation for trial subscriptions; access is suspended when an account is 30 or more days overdue.
confidence_note: The rates, minute allowances and plan names are quoted from Kobiton's own pricing page read on 2026-11-24; the trial's 300 minutes, sign-up methods and no-card statement are quoted from the same provider's free-trial registration page; the 30-day trial period and the Parallel Tests definition are quoted from the service subscription agreement.
